values.meaning: Magic damage per second dealt to enemies standing in the poison cloud
Duration the toxic clouds (and thus the poison damage window) persist at the target area
values.quote: creating toxic clouds at the area for 5 seconds

values.meaning: Actual number of damage ticks landing over the cloud's lifetime (the leveling table's Total Magic Damage assumes 20, giving 100-200; the wiki's own note says only 19 really land)
values.quote: there is 19 ticks and not 20 ticks
values.binNote: No bin data value gives Miasma's tick count (unlike Noxious Blast's explicit NumDamageTicks=7). The leveling table's Total Magic Damage (100 to 200, +50% AP) is exactly 5x the bin's per-second BaseDamage/DamagePerSecond calc, i.e. it assumes 20 ticks over the 5 s CloudDuration. The wiki's own note contradicts its own leveling table, stating only 19 ticks actually land, for a real total of 95 to 190 (+47.5% AP).

mechanics.claim: The wiki's own leveling table overstates Miasma's total damage: because only 19 (not 20) ticks actually land over the 5 s cloud duration, the real total is 95 to 190 magic damage (+47.5% AP), not the listed 100 to 200 (+50% AP).
mechanics.quote: because there is 19 ticks and not 20 ticks, the {{as|'''total''' magic damage}} is currently not {{as|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|magic damage}} but {{as|{{ap|95 to 190}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{fd|47.5}}% AP)}}

mechanics.claim: Miasma's tick count is itself inconsistent: besides the 19-vs-20 discrepancy, the wiki notes it sometimes lands only 18 ticks.
mechanics.quote: Sometimes ''Miasma'' randomly inflicts only 18 ticks of damage.
